History.LimitHint.zh: 默认 60，范围 1–10000。超出上限时删除最旧历史。
History.LimitHint.en: Default 60; range 1–10000. Excess history is removed oldest first.

History.InvalidLimit.zh: 请输入 1 到 10000 之间的整数。

History.NewQuestion.zh: 创建新画布？当前有效内容将保留到历史。
History.NewQuestion.en: Create a new canvas? Your current work will be kept in history.
